description:
The Firmstrong Black Rock 7-Speed takes cruising to a new level with oversized 29-inch wheels and enhanced performance. While taller riders love the extra leg room, everyone enjoys the advantages of the Black Rock’s smooth, efficient momentum. The seven speeds and handbrakes make this bike far more versatile than a standard cruiser, making it ideal for tackling hills or embarking on long-distance rides of over 15 miles. Optimized for men from 5'6" to 6'5" tall, the 19-inch aluminum frame ensures a spacious, comfortable fit for those who want more arm extension and a relaxed riding position.

At the core of the 29" Black Rock 7-Speed is the Shimano gear system, widely considered the best seven-speed option for a cruiser. This system uses a derailleur to move the chain between different sprockets as you shift gears. Gear one is the easiest to pedal, making it ideal for managing the large 29-inch wheels on inclines or maintaining a steady pace. Gear seven provides the most resistance for high-speed riding and smooth coasting. These gears give the bike the functionality of a hybrid or mountain bike, yet you still get to enjoy the signature upright riding position that saves your back and shoulders from strain.

To manage the increased speed and momentum of this 29-inch model, we’ve equipped it with front and rear Tektro V-brakes. These hand-operated brakes provide significantly more stopping power and precision control than a traditional coaster brake, which is essential for safely navigating descents or busy traffic with a high-capacity bike. The gear system also features a rear freewheel, so you can pedal backwards freely while riding without engaging the brakes. The Black Rock 7-Speed is a durable, high-performance upgrade for anyone who wants the classic cruiser look with the strength to go the distance.

19” Alloy Frame with 29” Aluminum Doule Wall Rim with 13G Spokes

7 Speed Shimano Bicycle has a wide range of gears for all types of riding; short rides, long distance and uphill riding

Front and Rear Tektro V Brakes are easy to operate and provide great stopping power even on downhill rides

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.1” Wide Black Tires provides a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Thick Rubber Grips

Bicycle Weighs approximately 34 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Men 5’6” – 6’5” Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 30mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 40 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 85% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
